sourceReview.reason: The Nov 12 AMBCrypto full report attributes the $607m Solana supply, 75% xStocks share, 2,102 products and 1.89m holder addresses to Blockworks, but a dated original Blockworks dataset establishing these figures was not verified. KuCoin reproduces the same AMBCrypto story, not independent reporting. The separately corroborated Nov 11 UK/EU xStocks expansion is already the subject of earlier xStocks review commits; do not repackage it as a new market-share event. Retry after six hours with original dated dataset or two independent full reports.
